definitions.gloss: vacant room; unoccupied room; room available for rent
definitions.explanation: A room that is currently empty and not occupied, whether in an apartment building, hotel, or office building. Often seen on signs and in real estate listings.

examples.japanese: このマンションには{空室|くうしつ}がほとんどない。
examples.english: There are hardly any vacant rooms in this apartment building.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{人気|にんき}エリアでは{空室|くうしつ}が{出|で}るとすぐに{埋|う}まってしまう。
examples.english: In the popular area near the station, any vacancy is filled immediately.

notes:
Commonly seen on signs outside apartment buildings and in real estate advertisements. The opposite is {満室|まんしつ} (no vacancy, fully occupied).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空室|くうしつ}あり (vacancy available)
- {空室|くうしつ}が{出|で}る (a vacancy opens up)
- {空室|くうしつ}{状況|じょうきょう} (vacancy status)
- {空室|くうしつ}{率|りつ} (vacancy rate)

USAGE NOTE:
For hotels, {空室|くうしつ} refers to available rooms. In real estate, it refers to apartments or offices available for rent. The sign {空室|くうしつ} on a building means rooms are available, while {満室|まんしつ} means fully occupied.
